title: Retain rejected-session persistence retry duty without churning the shared wire mutation stamp
outcome: Unchanged rejected rows retain persistence and prompt-history retry custody without repeatedly invalidating wire projections and session caches.
acceptance: Repeated successful sibling ticks with an unchanged rejected session preserve retry selection and last-good baseline without repeatedly advancing its wire-visible mutation stamp.
Concurrent newer mutation, removal and hiding preserve the current row owner's semantics; correction remains persistable and exact fences remain truthful.
